description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it. (Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.)
An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors. (Password must be at least 8 characters.)
A customer under 18 years old cannot register. (Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old.")

cases.title: Successful registration with all required fields valid, then sign in
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email address to be used (e.g. new.user@example.com) is not registered in the system.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 01.01.1990).
Open the sign-in page and sign in with new.user@example.com and Passw0rd123.
cases.expected: The account is created. Sign-in with the newly registered email and password succeeds. (Exact confirmation wording and post-registration screen are not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Registration with a required field left empty
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email to be used is not registered.
cases.expected: The account is not created, because first name is a required field. (The exact error message and its presentation are not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Registration with an email address that is already registered
cases.preconditions: An account already exists with the email existing.user@example.com.
steps: Check the account list / data for existing.user@example.com.
cases.expected: A clear error is shown and no second (duplicate) account is created for existing.user@example.com. (The exact error text is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Registration with an invalid email format
steps: Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the email field and the account is not created. (The exact error text is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Registration with a password shorter than 8 characters
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email to be used is not registered.
steps: Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the password field and the account is not created. (The exact error text is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Registration with a password of exactly 8 characters (minimum length boundary)
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email to be used is not registered.
cases.expected: No password length validation error is shown and the account is created, because the password meets the minimum of 8 characters.

cases.title: Registration attempt by a customer under 18 years old
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email to be used is not registered.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer 15 years old today (e.g. today's date minus 15 years).
cases.expected: Registration is refused and the message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown. No account is created.

cases.title: Registration one day before the 18th birthday
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email to be used is not registered.
steps: Enter date of birth: today's date minus 18 years plus 1 day (18th birthday is tomorrow).
cases.expected: Age calculated from the date of birth is 17, so registration is refused with the message "You must be at least 18 years old." and no account is created.

cases.title: Registration on the 18th birthday
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email to be used is not registered.
steps: Enter date of birth: today's date minus exactly 18 years (18th birthday is today).
cases.expected: Age calculated from the date of birth is 18, so the customer is not under 18: no age message is shown and the account is created.
